name: ai-google-maps-scraper
title: AI Google Maps Scraper | Natural-Language Business Leads
description:
Scrape Google Maps business listings using a plain-English query. Returns structured JSON leads with name, address, rating, phone, and website. No config, no CSS selectors, no API keys.

INPUT: a single natural-language string describing the businesses you want.

Example input:
{"query": "coffee shops in Austin TX with phone numbers"}

Example output (one dataset item):
{"name": "Epoch Coffee", "address": "221 W North Loop Blvd, Austin, TX 78751", "rating": 4.5, "phone": "+1 512-454-3762", "website": "https://epochcoffee.com"}

Use cases: local lead generation, B2B prospecting, sales CRM enrichment, market research, competitor analysis. Works for any business category and location worldwide that Google Maps indexes.
